server_not_found: Server not found. Run `alice dav list` to list them

open_calendar_failed: Could not open the file in your calendar app

invite.title: Invitation: {title}
invite.you_change: You        {state} · change it with `alice invite {id} accept|tentative|decline`

draft_saved:
Draft saved: {id}
Send with: alice send {id}
mcp_read_only_on: AI agents can now read your mail through `alice mcp`. Allow changes and sending with `alice mcp full`; stop access with `alice mcp off`.
mcp_full: AI agents now have full access to your mail through `alice mcp`: they can read, organize, draft and send. Stop access with `alice mcp off`.
mcp_off: AI agents can no longer use your mail.
mcp_disabled: Alice does not allow AI agents to use mail. Ask the person to choose Read only or Full access for AI agents in Alice Settings, or to run `alice mcp read-only` or `alice mcp full`.
mcp_read_only: Alice gives AI agents read-only access, so this tool is not available. Ask the person to choose Full access for AI agents in Alice Settings, or to run `alice mcp full`.

commands.root: Email client. Run without arguments for the TUI.
commands.help: Print this message or the help of the given subcommand(s)
commands.daemon: Start the shared local mail daemon in the foreground.
commands.daemon_run: Run the shared local mail daemon in the foreground.
commands.daemon_status: Show the local mail daemon's status.
commands.daemon_stop: Stop the shared local mail daemon.
commands.list: List messages. JSON output is suitable for scripts.
commands.read: Read a message and mark it read.
commands.reply: Create a reply draft; send only with --send.
commands.compose: Compose a draft; send only with --send.
commands.send: Send an existing draft (never automatically retried).
commands.discard: Discard an unsent local draft. This never deletes provider mail.
commands.spam: Mark a message as spam by moving it to the provider's Spam folder. Whether its spam filter learns from that depends on the provider.
commands.restore: Restore a message to Inbox, marking Spam mail as not spam.
commands.star: Star a message, or remove its star with --remove.
commands.accounts_add: Connect through OAuth, or an app password for generic IMAP/Gmail.
commands.accounts_remove: Remove a connected account and its mail, drafts and sign-in from this device. Provider mail is untouched.
commands.accounts_access: Let Alice read a Gmail or Outlook account's address book or calendars. Turning access on asks for consent in your browser.
commands.ai: Configure AI and ask Alice about your mail.
commands.ai_configure: Store a BYOK connection. The key is prompted without echo.
commands.ai_ask: Ask Alice about one message or the newest 20 inbox messages. Plans are only proposals.
commands.contacts: Suggested recipients from your mail and connected address books.
commands.contacts_search: Best match first: the start of any word of a name, or of an address.
commands.contacts_sync: Refresh contacts from Google, Microsoft and CardDAV address books now.
commands.dav: CardDAV address books and CalDAV calendars signed in with a password.
commands.dav_list: List connected CardDAV and CalDAV servers.
commands.dav_add: Sign in to a CardDAV or CalDAV server. The password is prompted without echo.
commands.dav_remove: Remove a server, its contacts and its stored password from this device.
commands.invite: Answer a calendar invitation. The reply is mailed to the organizer.
commands.calendar: Put invitations on your calendar and see when you are busy. Alice keeps no events itself.
commands.calendar_list: Calendars that invitations can be added to.
commands.calendar_busy: Busy times across connected calendars, in local time. Titles are never shown.
commands.calendar_add: Add an invitation to a calendar (default: the one chosen in Settings).
commands.calendar_export: Save an invitation as an .ics file, or open it in your calendar app with --open.
commands.mcp: Serve your mail to AI agents over MCP (stdio). `off`, `read-only` or `full` sets what agents may do.

args.account: Account ID or email address, as shown by `alice accounts`.
args.search: Search query, best match first: words, "phrases", -exclusions, OR, from:, to:, subject:, body:, is:unread|read|starred, has:attachment, after:/before:/date:.
args.body_file: Read the message body from this file
args.send: Send instead of saving a draft
args.to: Recipient email addresses, separated by commas
args.subject: Message subject
args.query: Contact name or email address to search for
args.name: Display name
args.url: The server or account URL; address books and calendars are discovered from it.
args.source: Source ID or name, as shown by `alice dav list`.
args.calendar: Calendar ID, as shown by `alice calendar list`.
args.open: Open the invitation in your calendar app
args.app_password: Sign in with an app password instead of OAuth
args.contacts: Turn address book access on or off
args.message: Ask about this message instead of the newest inbox messages
args.access: AI agent access: off, read-only (search and read) or full (also organize, draft and send)

contacts_search.account: Rank this sending account's address book and correspondents first.

accounts_access.calendar: Turn calendar access on or off

accounts_add.provider: Mail provider: gmail, outlook, or imap
